senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; רזן to be strong, heavy) prince.—Pl. רוֹזְנִים.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 70b:5">Snh. 70ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 31:4">Prov. XXXI, 4</cite>) <he>מי שכל רוֹזְנֵי עולם וכ׳</he> should he at whose door the princes of the world appear every morning, drink wine and become drunken? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:5">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>, end (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>שני ר׳ היו לי וכ׳</he> two princes (Nadab and Abihu) were mine, and they died only on account of wine; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 320:1">Yalk. Jer. 320</cite>; a. e.
